summary: Grocery Dive reports that Senators Elizabeth Warren and Robert P. Casey Jr. questioned Kroger’s electronic shelf label technology over potential dynamic pricing, price gouging, and privacy concerns. Kroger responded that the tests are intended to lower prices and refuted suggestions otherwise, but the article says Kroger’s emailed statement did not address the consumer-data privacy concerns.
